method_sources: Schlichtkrull et al R-GCN 2018 PyTorch Geometric RGCNConv
VaGraM ICLR 2022 decision-aware dynamics optimization motivation
predeclared_model: two PyG RGCNConv layers hidden32, pooled predicted H5+H20 5-field system-state summary conditioned by explicit proposed robot-task action edges
use_fixed_original_pr30_score: negative predicted H20 completed-stage count, SAME for prediction-only and joint-training models, no new ranker
checkpoint_selection: minimum validation true counterfactual regret, tie -> lower validation normalized H5/H20 prediction MSE, and do not use test outcomes
model_quality_endpoints: pairwise candidate ordering accuracy excluding true ties
true regret vs best candidate after same action prefix
limitations: 72 paired scenario groups only (36 train/12 validation/24 independent test), same-map synthetic pilot, not final publication-scale training or GPU serving benchmark
